notes.title: 2.7.3 Released - Skydiving, Zombie Mode & Processors
notes.notes:
2.7 is almost complete, we now can turn into zombies (after you've been infected) sky dive, and process ore and other materials into new and more useful materials.

Up next is god/admin mode, bug fixes, map additions and a few surprises.  Stay tuned.


Change Log
---


engine: upgraded to unreal engine 4.19.2
new: parachute added - allows for falling from great heights
new: zombie mode - can revive as a zombie if (a: body is intact, and b: body is 100% infected)
new: zombie meat - cooked and uncooked, does damage if you eat it, but increases your infection level
new: human meat - cooked and uncooked, only zombies like to eat this
new: pig meat - cooked and uncooked, really high food content
new: launchers now fire missiles again
new processors - converts resources into other resources. Each processor has 3 types which use fuel and processes at different rates
Food Processors (fire, large fire and cooking station) - turn raw meat into meat
Ore Processor ( furnace, huge furnace, efficient furnace) - turns ore/scrap into metal/gold
Oil Processor (Oil Refinery, Oil Refinery Huge, Oil Refinery Efficient) - turns oil into gas.
new: new inventory transfer screen allows for grid placement of inventory items
bugfix: palm tree and crate meshes now correct
tweak: free players on mobile can now get to level 10
tweak: most food give less food now that we have cooked foods
tweak: zombies more faster
tweak: when repairing an item, it will lose a level

notes.title: 2.7.1 Released - More Vendor Features
notes.notes:
Features have been added to allow players to retain wealth.  Getting killed before resulted in a total loss of everything - now you can store some items, gold and cars.  More coming soon - thanks for your support.

Change Log
----------------

new: car garage - store and recall your vehicle from various garage locations throughout the map for a cost of 100 gold
new: personal storage - inside the newbton safezone and the markets there is a locker that you can store your personal items safely
new: banker - you can save your gold at the banker - this banked gold can be used from all the vendors. (note: This feature requires pro on mobile)
new: the repair vendor can repair the clothing/armor you are currently wearing
new: banker/vendors can convert gold bars to coins automatically for you and is counted in your total gold #
bugfix: gold bars picked up from npcs had damage to them devaluing them
tweak: player info tag is only visible if you look at the player directly first - was way too easy to track players down being always on
upgraded: burger shop and mayors residence have been brought up to v2 standards

Full Change Log - http://bitporters.net/zta/change_log.html

notes.title: 2.7.0 Released - The Gold Standard
notes.notes:
The Gold Standard release brings new guns, vendors and many fixes to the game.  More coming soon!

new: new player info card, shows HP and ARMOR
new: many new guns, lmg, smg, ar, rifle, shotguns and airsoft
new: more bullet types added, airsoft, 22, 357,  567, 762, .50 cal
new: newbton safe zone - start here with a few vendors to get you started
new: vendors - can buy and sell items.  value of items depends on level/durability
new: gold coins, bars and ore created - gold is now the in world currency, bars will be granted if sales transactions are over 1000.  1 gold bar  can be sold for 1000 coins
new: repair vendor - can repair items up to specific durability levels.  Find different repair vendors to repair to higher levels of durability.
new: input settings has been expanded to have input settings for on foot, in vehicle and aircraft - each setting group has sensitivity and inversion options
new: inventory ui improved and stats window in inventory now shows more information
new: when objects pop in/out from culling, it its now animated
new: free brains for checking out the discord/forum and steam page for the game - thank you for looking at our other platforms and sharing the game

new: stance system  - able to sit/sleep from a radial menu, hold shift to run, tap shift to bring up radial.  		
----------------
sleep = fastest health/energy regen and slowest food burn
sit = faster health/energy regen and slow food burn
walk = normal food burn and health regen, no energy burn on movement
walk = fast food burn and no health regen, energy burn on movement
----------------

tweak: resource extraction rules
----------------
vehicles - wrench required
trees - axe required
rocks - pickaxe required
most objects - crowbar required
farmed food - fists or scythe required
meat from corpses - knife required
----------------

tweak: hunger system, no more damage on starvation
tweak: energy system, only burns energy when you are running (and moving) - no more energy burn on overloaded inventory
tweak: extreme damage (10x more than HP MAX) will insta gib npcs and players, be careful if you want that loot
tweak: xp - you earn more XP if your food/hunger is above 50% - you learn less xp if less than 50%
tweak: damage application across the board now randomly applies instead of 100% full application every time
tweak: can now zoom while free looking with mouse wheel, also can't switch inventory item when free looking
tweak: barn interiors improved and doors upgraded to v2
tweak: searchables now lets you know when they can be searched again
tweak: loot spawning in containers and npc corpses tweaked to a better model and use less CPU
tweak: ground vehicles work better multiplayer and respond better

bugfix: while free looking, can't aim down sight, or while aim down sight, cannot free look
bugfix: cant build boats on land
bugfix: energy consumption is correct now - before around 10% energy weird things would happen
bugfix: armor refreshes correctly on death/reload
bugfix: current armor updates correctly when damaged
bugfix: statue of libery collision fixed
bugfix: navmesh was randomly failing causing AI to just stand there

tweak: v2 door upgrades: barber shop, strip club, bakery
tweak: changed speed reduction of being overweight/out of energy to 50/60% instead of 10/20%, as that wasnt fun for people
tweak: changed jump blocking weight from ideal weight (yellow) to red - so you can jump when slighly overload - for the fun
tweak: alerts on why you cant jump, i.e. energy or weight issue
ai: NPC AI - disengages if loses sight
ai: NPC AI - disengages if distance > 5000 (a city block)
ai: NPC AI - engage if hear player running/walking

notes.title: 2.6.0.10243 (Beta 5) has been released for both PC & Android
notes.notes:
This build cleans up a lot of bugs with the new vehicles as well introduces how the new vehicles will become stronger.

New blocks have been added 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/joXjhfY.gif[/img]

XP Block - hit a vehicle with this to give it experience.  As the vehicle levels up, it will gain more MAX hit-points.  If the vehicle is capable of being armored, it will gain more MAX armor hit-points.

Armor Block - hit a vehicle with this block to add armor HPs.  This will increase the total HP of a vehicle.  Note: if you boost while driving your vehicle, it will not go against your armor HP.

- these new blocks will drop on npc kills, a special block that is 100x more effect will drop from bosses (more on that later)

- more V2 door upgrades - bakery, mini-mall, stripclub

- tweaks to zombie AI and spawner logic.  Zombie now hear you if you are running/moving near them.  They will come and investigate.

- aircraft/planes now use mouse input to change your direction

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uyLD3XO.gif[/img]

notes.title: 2.5.1 Released - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Still a lot more to do in 2.5.x but got a round of bug fixes out, stay tuned for more

new: more buildings have new open/close style doors
new: new water shader (disabled on low gfx settings)
new: crashed airplane now has lootable luggage around it
new: 4 new guns (creative mode only) to randomly spawn NPCs quickly
new: can spawn pigs from creative mode now
tweak: effects now scale based on graphic settings, on mobile devices these should be kept low (low by default)
tweak: newbton spawns loot way faster now
tweak: loot spawn also affected by # of people online, more people = more loot spawns
tweak: newbton and crashed airplane now spawn loot at a way faster rate
tweak: added ladder teleporters to pool in big city
tweak: smaller death match map - zombie/loot range adjusted to 1-255 instead of all 255
tweak: zombie spawners sets buildings to contain either survivor, zombie or bandit (so no more battle royale everywhere)
tweak: grenades are not stackable anymore (because they can be different levels), also no more grenade spam
bugfix: hp correctly updating on zombies, on destructible items
bugfix: on body explosion, camera stays where your body was
bugfix: build rotation keys added to key list (page up/page down)
bugfix: build mode toggle key works (tab)
bugfix: helicopter rotation controls added (left-right)
bugfix: clothing no longer gets stained by blood incorrectly
bugfix: if trying to build something and it doesn't work, couldnt build again until you reselected that item
bugfix: rotation of npcs are correct now compared to build preview
bugfix: sometimes when reconnecting your highlighted item in your hot bar was different than what you were holding
bugfix: if you buy a spawn point spawn, you can buy another one on your next death
bugfix: npcs hit at correct damage level now
bugfix: damage scaling works correctly with grenades and RPGs now

notes.title: 2.5.0 Released - the "things to do" release
notes.notes:
The major goal of 2.5 is to create more things to do in the game - the 3 major parts are new NPCs, dungeons, and a reason to go into the dungeons (scaled gear).  More dungeons will be added soon.

	[h1]Unreal Engine: 4.15.1[/h1]
	[h1]---------[/h1]
	[list]
		[*]new: new npc types (bandits, more zombies, pigs) 
		[*]new: dungeons - first dungeon The Hospital has been introduced.  More to come real soon.	
		[*]new: inventory screen and equip screen - split out into different tabs)
		[*]new: npcs now have levels, 1-255
		[*]new: weapons and armor now have levels 1-255
		[*]new: armor also has TIERS, ie. a tier 1 hat (i.e a baseball cap) is worse than a tier 4 hat (i.e military hat)
		[*]new: dungeon browser tab added to map
		[*]new: spawn point screen updated
		[*]new: random spawn accounts for level of you vs the spawn points, ie. wont put newbs in level 200 land
		[*]new: new AI system, enemies engage in different ways depending on type.
		[*]new: settings window - sound levels can now be managed
		[*]new: host menu - game host can now adjust name of game and host settings from within the game.
		[*]new: PC version very close - if you buy pro on android, email service@bitporters.net your GPA# and I will give you a steam key (i.e. GPA.XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXX)
		[*]new: dash screen has quick buttons to chat options + selfie cam for screenshots.
		[*]new: pre-launch game settings window, can now adjust amount of zombies/survivors/bandits/animals
		
		[*]bugfix: better in game crash reporting
		[*]tweak: upgrade to unreal 4.15
		[*]tweak: when a weapon/armor breaks, it doesn't dissapear, it just becomes unusable/doesnt grant protection
		[*]tweak: more brains granted if you share the game on social media, thank you for supporting this game.
		[*]tweak: NPC spawner only spawns specific NPCs at specific times of the day
		
		[*]android: only pro accounts can buy brains
		[*]android: buying pro unlocks all the game modes
		[*]translations updated
	[/list]
	
Full change log here - www.bitporters.net/zta/change_log.html
